pkgmetadata.longdescription: reviewdog takes the output of any linter, on stdin or through an errorformat, and turns it into review comments. Its point is the filtering: it reports only the findings that fall on lines the current diff touches, so introducing the tool into an old codebase does not bury the author under pre-existing warnings. It posts to GitHub, GitLab, Gerrit and Bitbucket, and also runs purely locally.
